description: Central definition of environmental, climate, water and WASH indicators used by EPAY.

indicatorStatus.LIVE: Indicator currently calculated from connected live data.
indicatorStatus.VERIFIED: Indicator definition has been verified but is not currently connected to a live source.
indicatorStatus.MODELLED: Indicator is calculated by a model or analytical method.
indicatorStatus.DEMO: Indicator is used for demonstration only.
indicatorStatus.UNAVAILABLE: Required data is not currently available.

indicators.name: Rainfall
indicators.description: Observed or modelled precipitation information used as a climate and hazard input.
indicators.calculationMethod: Source-dependent precipitation value or derived precipitation statistic.
limitations: Source availability varies.
Spatial and temporal resolution depends on the selected dataset.
A forecast value must not be represented as an observed value.

indicators.name: Temperature
indicators.description: Temperature information used for climate monitoring and environmental risk analysis.
indicators.calculationMethod: Observed, forecast or derived temperature value depending on the source.
limitations: Forecast and observed temperatures must be clearly distinguished.
Spatial resolution depends on the source.

indicators.name: Wind Speed
indicators.description: Wind speed used to provide weather and hazard context.
limitations: Forecast information is not equivalent to an official warning.
Local observations may differ from gridded or modelled values.

indicators.name: Water Stress
indicators.description: Composite indicator intended to represent pressure on available water resources.
indicators.calculationMethod: To be defined and validated using appropriate water-resource variables.
limitations: No live national calculation is claimed at this stage.
The methodology requires validation with water-resource specialists.
A composite index must not be presented as a direct measurement.

indicators.name: Drought Risk
indicators.description: Prototype risk indicator combining selected climate and water-stress signals.
indicators.calculationMethod: Composite model to be validated before operational use.
limitations: Prototype indicator.
Not an official drought declaration.
Model weights require validation.
Results must include uncertainty information.

indicators.name: Flood Risk
indicators.description: Prototype indicator intended to estimate relative flood or flash-flood risk.
indicators.calculationMethod: Prototype composite risk model using available precipitation, terrain, exposure and related variables.
limitations: Prototype only.
Requires validation against historical and observed events.
Must not replace official warnings.
Local drainage and terrain information may be incomplete.

indicators.name: Air Quality
indicators.description: Air-quality indicator when a supported air-quality data source is connected.
indicators.calculationMethod: Provider-defined air-quality index or pollutant-derived calculation.
limitations: Coverage depends on available monitoring or modelled data.
Provider methodology must be documented.

indicators.name: Vegetation Health
indicators.description: Remote-sensing-derived indicator intended to support ecosystem and drought analysis.
indicators.calculationMethod: Remote-sensing vegetation index or related derived metric.
limitations: Exact index must be specified when a dataset is selected.
Cloud contamination and spatial resolution may affect results.

indicators.name: WASH Risk
indicators.description: Planned composite indicator for water, sanitation and hygiene vulnerability.
indicators.calculationMethod: To be defined using validated WASH indicators.
limitations: No national live WASH risk score is claimed.
Indicator selection requires consultation with WASH specialists.
Composite scoring requires validation.

indicators.name: Environmental Priority Score
indicators.description: Prototype decision-support score intended to rank locations for further assessment or intervention.
indicators.calculationMethod: Planned composite model combining hazard, exposure, vulnerability, consequence and data-confidence factors.
limitations: Prototype methodology.
Weights must be validated with domain experts and users.
Priority score is a decision-support tool and not a legal or official classification.
